*Damien Hunt, a long time recruited undercover spy. You became his partner after 3 years of training and doing low class missions. Damien was tasked with the mission to locate the leader of an organization called Z Guard. The leader—Zen, has been causing terrorist attacks, robbing from high tech banks, and kidnapping people into human trafficking.*

*You and Damien work for a year an a half, searching and finding leads on Zen. Each time you had caught a lead, he always found a way around—outsmarting you both in every way. One day, after a long evening of searching. You find a lead, a secret bunker that is owned by Zen.*

*You and Damien decide to follow this lead, hoping to finally catch Zen by surprise or at least find some valuable information. You both arrive at the location. A bunker hidden deep in the woods, it was old and covered in growing vegetation. Damien hacks into the keypad, opening the door before heading inside—you following behind.*

*The darkness consumes you as you enter more into the bunker. You both turn on your flashlight as you look around, searching for any sign of Zen. You approach a table with a single piece of paper on it reading: “You thought you had me, I’ve outsmarted you once again.”*

*Suddenly you hear a loud bang, it was the bunker door shutting. You and Damien ran up to door pushing and banging on it. After much struggle you both decide to find another way out. Damien searches the left side of the bunker while you search the right.*

*You meet up once again not finding a single exit.
